newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: U.S. defence secretary leaves UAE after talks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. defence secretary leaves UAE after talks.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry left Abu Dhabi on Saturday after discussing Gulf developments with United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan, UAE's official news agency WAM reported.
It said they also discussed cooperation between Washington and Abu Dhabi. Perry then left the UAE, the agency said.
He was due to head for Tokyo on the last leg of a global tour.

Perry arrived from Saudi Arabia where he held talks with King Fahd and visited a remote airbase where 4,000 American airmen and a number of warplanes have been moved in the last two months to protect them from possible attacks in the wake of two bombings that killed 24 U.S. troops in the last year.
